name: tabby-advanced-highlight
description: Tabby plugin for advanced terminal text and regex highlighting with custom colors and real-time settings

scripts.deploy: npm run build && mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/Application Support/tabby/plugins/node_modules/tabby-advanced-highlight" && cp -rf ./dist ./package.json "$HOME/Library/Application Support/tabby/plugins/node_modules/tabby-advanced-highlight/" && mkdir -p /Users/ruben/bin/tabby-advanced-highlight && cp -rf ./dist ./package.json /Users/ruben/bin/tabby-advanced-highlight/
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm pack && mkdir -p .portable/tabby-advanced-highlight && cp -rf dist package.json README.md LICENSE .portable/tabby-advanced-highlight/ && tar -czf tabby-advanced-highlight-portable.tar.gz -C .portable tabby-advanced-highlight && tar -cf tabby-advanced-highlight-portable.tar -C .portable tabby-advanced-highlight && rm -rf .portable
